name: skill-ai
description: Personal skill marketplace for rizalvalry. Single plugin (skill-ai): a Claude Code Engineering OS with 18 intent commands, 10 specialist subagents, 11 role skills, 6 domain reference skills, project-context templates, and documented MCP slots — governed by no-duplication ownership boundaries and split-contract handoffs.

plugins.name: skill-ai
plugins.description: Commands (/plan-work /build /fix /hunt /test /refactor /map /trace /architect /ai-design /agent-audit /rag /prompt /eval /security /devops /devops-apply /gate) fork read-only work to specialist subagents (planner, solution-architect, bug-hunter, qa-engineer, ai-engineer, security-reviewer, devops-engineer, gatekeeper) and keep mutable work in the main session under the developer skill. `project-manager` is the OWNER layer that routes and gates without deciding. Reference skills (backend, frontend, azure, ai-foundry, rag-patterns, database) inform without deciding. Built-in commands (/plan, /code-review, /security-review, /verify, /debug) are never shadowed.
